A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic case-study report on digital-city governance. Clean white background with a very faint light-blue tint.

Composition: a large closed triangular cycle occupying the centre of a wide canvas. Three big rounded cards sit at the three vertices, connected by thick blue curved arrows running clockwise to form a closed loop.

Top vertex card: a deep-blue rounded header bar with white Chinese text "授权环境"; inside the card three short Chinese lines: "国家试点政策赋权", "政企合资主体授权", "产学研协同资源授权".
Lower-right vertex card: deep-blue header bar with white Chinese text "运营能力"; inside three Chinese lines: "城市大脑技术底座", "全域公共数据平台", "高端人才与科创平台".
Lower-left vertex card: deep-blue header bar with white Chinese text "公共价值"; inside three Chinese lines: "治理提效", "民生普惠", "示范外溢".

The clockwise arrows carry small Chinese labels: from 授权环境 to 运营能力 "资源转化"; from 运营能力 to 公共价值 "能力落地"; from 公共价值 back to 授权环境 "增值反哺".

In the exact centre of the triangle, a light-blue circular badge with deep-blue Chinese text on two lines: "动态均衡" and "循环强化".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners, subtle soft light-blue gradient fills inside cards. Strict palette: deep blue #1B4C9C for header bars and headline text, medium blue #2B6CD4 for arrows and icons, very light blue #EAF2FD to #D6E6FA gradient for card fills, dark grey #333333 for body text. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, generous whitespace, symmetrical balance.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no heavy drop shadows, no lens flare, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report, laid out as a two-column mapping diagram on a clean white background with a faint light-blue tint.

A deep-blue title bar spans the top with white Chinese text "战略三角模型的理论要求与嘉数实践的对应关系".

Below it, the canvas splits into a LEFT column headed by a medium-blue pill with white Chinese text "理论要求" and a RIGHT column headed by a medium-blue pill with white Chinese text "嘉数实践". Three horizontal rows pair the two columns, each row linked by a thick blue double-headed arrow in the middle carrying a small Chinese label.

Row 1 — left card Chinese text "合法性与外部支持", right card Chinese text "国家试点资质、政企合资、产学研网络", middle arrow label "授权对应".
Row 2 — left card Chinese text "实现目标的运营能力", right card Chinese text "城市大脑、公共数据平台、科创人才体系", middle arrow label "能力对应".
Row 3 — left card Chinese text "可界定的公共价值目标", right card Chinese text "治理提效、民生普惠、示范外溢", middle arrow label "价值对应".

A slim light-blue strip runs across the very bottom with deep-blue Chinese text "三维要求全部对应，且形成增值反哺授权的动态闭环".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners, subtle light-blue gradient card fills. Strict palette: deep blue #1B4C9C, medium blue #2B6CD4, very light blue #EAF2FD card fills, dark grey #333333 body text. Simple flat line-art icons only where helpful. All labels in Simplified Chinese, crisp correctly-formed characters, clean sans-serif. Wide 3:2 landscape composition, precise row alignment, generous whitespace.
Strictly avoid: no photorealism, no 3D bevel, no heavy drop shadows, no stock-photo people, no watermark, no signature, no English text, no decorative clutter, no gibberish characters.

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report showing a research-data triangulation design, on a clean white background with a faint light-blue tint.

Three rounded cards are arranged as a triangle: one at the upper left, one at the upper right, one at the bottom centre. Thin blue double-headed arrows connect all three cards to each other, forming a triangle of mutual verification.

Upper-left card: deep-blue header bar with white Chinese text "半结构化访谈"; inside three short Chinese lines: "企业管理层", "政府主管部门", "合作高校人员".
Upper-right card: deep-blue header bar with white Chinese text "二手档案资料"; inside three Chinese lines: "项目验收报告", "专利与软件著作权", "资质认证文件".
Bottom-centre card: deep-blue header bar with white Chinese text "公开政策文本"; inside three Chinese lines: "国家与省级规划", "试点批复文件", "行业标准文本".

In the middle of the triangle, a light-blue circular badge with deep-blue Chinese text on two lines: "三角验证" and "证据互证".

A slim deep-blue banner runs across the bottom of the figure with white Chinese text "多源证据交叉印证，保障单案例研究的构念效度".

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report. Clean white background with a faint light-blue tint. Layout: three vertical panels side by side across a wide canvas, with a shared deep-blue title bar at the very top carrying white Chinese text "授权环境的三个可设计子维度".

Left panel: a medium-blue rounded header pill with white Chinese text "政策授权"; below it a light-blue card with a small flat line icon and three short Chinese lines: "国家十四五重点研发专项", "科技部百城百园试点", "省级数字化改革部署"; under the card a thin outlined box with deep-blue Chinese text "解决：凭什么建".
Middle panel: header pill "出资授权"; card with icon and three Chinese lines: "市政府平台公司控股", "中国电科参股出资", "五亿元注册资本"; outlined box with Chinese text "解决：拿什么建".
Right panel: header pill "治理授权"; card with icon and three Chinese lines: "董事会领导下总经理负责制", "政府控股与央企经营分离", "公共数据统筹归集权限"; outlined box with Chinese text "解决：如何决策".

A thick blue horizontal arrow runs beneath the three panels from left to right, labeled in Chinese "由静态背景变量转为可设计的制度工具".

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic for a Chinese academic report, on a clean white background with a faint light-blue tint. Layout: a horizontal three-tier funnel flowing left to right, then widening into three outcome cards.

On the LEFT, a deep-blue rounded block with white Chinese text on two lines "运营赋能能力" and "技术·数据·人才". A thick blue arrow points right from it into a medium-blue vertical divider labeled in white Chinese text "场景落地".

On the RIGHT of the divider, three light-blue rounded cards stacked vertically, each with a small flat line icon, a deep-blue Chinese heading and two short Chinese detail lines:
card 1 heading "治理提效", details "矛盾纠纷特征提炼由三天压缩至三十分钟" and "基层网格全流程线上闭环";
card 2 heading "民生普惠", details "智慧教育、交通、医疗、政务多场景覆盖" and "高频民生服务一网通办";
card 3 heading "示范外溢", details "入选省级数商创新优秀典型案例" and "参与国家标准编制输出行业规范".

A long thin blue arrow curves from the right edge back to the left block along the bottom, labeled in Chinese "价值反哺，拓宽授权边界".

A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat vector infographic roadmap for a Chinese academic report, laid out as a horizontal timeline running left to right across a wide canvas. Clean white background with a faint light-blue tint.

A thick horizontal blue baseline arrow runs across the middle, ending in an arrowhead. Four deep-blue circular milestone markers sit on the line, numbered 01, 02, 03, 04 in white.

Above each marker sits a deep-blue rounded title pill with white Chinese text: above 01 "平台搭建期", above 02 "能力认证期", above 03 "要素运营期", above 04 "品牌外溢期".
Below each marker sits a light-blue rounded card with two short Chinese lines. Below 01: "自研基础平台，破除数据孤岛" and "建好平台". Below 02: "通过研发与运维能力认证" and "证明能力". Below 03: "公共数据授权运营与资产化" and "运营数据". Below 04: "参与国家标准编制与跨域推广" and "输出标准".

At the far left edge, a vertical deep-blue side tab with white Chinese text reading "能力逐层跃升". Along the very bottom, a slim light-blue strip with deep-blue Chinese text "适配条件：稳定的政策授权、建管一体的运营主体、可持续的要素供给".

Style: flat vector infographic, clean white background, thin uniform 2px stroke weight, rounded corners, subtle light-blue gradient card fills.
